title: [Ergosterol peroxide inhibits proliferation of breast cancer MDA-MB-231 cells via synergistic ferroptosis and mitochondrial-dependent apoptosis mediated by p53 signaling pathway].
authors: Hou, Li-Man; Luo, Ran; Wang, Qi; Wang, Lu; Deng, Si-Qi; Bu, Ming; Lin, Yu
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 研究麦角固醇过氧化物通过p53信号通路诱导三阴性乳腺癌细胞铁死亡和凋亡，核心为细胞实验与蛋白组学，无蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Based on proteomic methods, this paper aims to explore the target and action mechanism of ergosterol peroxide(EP) against triple-negative breast cancer. The effect of EP on the viability of breast cancer MDA-MB-231 cells was detected by the MTT method. The effect of EP on apoptosis, mitochondrial membrane potential(detected by JC-1), reactive oxygen species(ROS), and the cell cycle of MDA-MB-231 cells was detected by flow cytometry. The subcellular localization and differentially expressed proteins of MDA-MB-231 cells treated with EP were obtained by proteomic technology based on tandem mass spectrometry. GO function and KEGG enrichment analysis were conducted through the eggNOG and KAAS databases. A protein-protein interaction(PPI) network was constructed via the STRING database. Malondialdehyde(MDA), superoxide dismutase(SOD), and glutathione(GSH) concentrations, as well as iron contents, were measured using a microplate reader. A Western blot was performed to detect the expression of relevant proteins, and molecular docking was used to validate the binding affinity of EP to relevant core target proteins. MTT results demonstrate that EP significantly inhibits MDA-MB-231 cell viability in a time-and concentration-dependent manner. The results of flow cytometry show that after MDA-MB-231 cells are treated with EP of 10, 20, and 40 mumol.L~(-1) for 48 hours, the total apoptosis rate of the cells increases significantly. The mitochondrial membrane potential decreased significantly; the level of ROS increased significantly; cell cycle arrest occurred in the G_0/G_1 phase. Proteomic results demonstrate that compared with those in the blank group, 895 differentially expressed proteins are identified in the EP group, with 326 upregulated proteins and 569 downregulated proteins. Bioinformatics pathway enrichment analysis indicates significant enrichment of ferroptosis and tumor protein p53 signaling pathways among these differentially expressed proteins, suggesting that EP may exert an inhibitory effect on MDA-MB-231 cell proliferation through multiple pathways. The Western blot results show that the protein expressions of cytochrome C(Cyt C), B-cell lymphoma-2(Bcl-2)-associated X protein(Bax), cleaved cysteine-aspartic acid protease-7(cleaved caspase-7), heme oxygenase 1(HOMX1), p53, and p21 protein are increased in MDA-MB-231 cells treated with EP. In contrast, the protein expressions of Bcl-2, solute carrier family 7 member 11(SLC7A11), glutathione peroxidase 4(GPX4), regulatory subunit of glutamate-cysteine ligase(GCLM), p62 protein, and cyclin-dependent kinase 4(CDK4) are decreased. The above findings suggest that EP may promote apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells by regulating the p53 signaling pathway and inducing ferroptosis.
abstract_zh: 基于蛋白质组学方法，本文旨在探讨过氧化麦角甾醇（EP）对三阴性乳腺癌的靶点及作用机制。采用MTT法检测EP对乳腺癌MDA-MB-231细胞活力的影响。通过流式细胞术检测EP对MDA-MB-231细胞凋亡、线粒体膜电位（以JC-1检测）、活性氧（ROS）及细胞周期的影响。通过基于串联质谱的蛋白质组学技术，获得经EP处理的MDA-MB-231细胞的亚细胞定位及差异表达蛋白。通过eggNOG和KAAS数据库进行GO功能和KEGG富集分析。通过STRING数据库构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。使用酶标仪测定丙二醛（MDA）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、谷胱甘肽（GSH）浓度及铁含量。采用Western blot检测相关蛋白表达，并通过分子对接验证EP与相关核心靶蛋白的结合亲和力。MTT结果表明，EP以时间和浓度依赖性方式显著抑制MDA-MB-231细胞活力。流式细胞术结果显示，经10、20和40 μmol·L~(-1)的EP处理MDA-MB-231细胞48小时后，细胞总凋亡率显著增加。线粒体膜电位显著降低；ROS水平显著升高；细胞周期阻滞于G_0/G_1期。蛋白质组学结果表明，与空白组相比，EP组鉴定出895个差异表达蛋白，其中上调蛋白326个，下调蛋白569个。生物信息学通路富集分析显示，这些差异表达蛋白中显著富集了铁死亡和肿瘤蛋白p53信号通路，提示EP可能通过多条通路对MDA-MB-231细胞增殖发挥抑制作用。Western blot结果显示，经EP处理的MDA-MB-231细胞中，细胞色素C（Cyt C）、B细胞淋巴瘤-2（Bcl-2）相关X蛋白（Bax）、裂解的半胱氨酸-天冬氨酸蛋白酶-7（cleaved caspase-7）、血红素加氧酶1（HOMX1）、p53和p21蛋白表达增加。相反，Bcl-2、溶质载体家族7成员11（SLC7A11）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）、谷氨酸-半胱氨酸连接酶调节亚基（GCLM）、p62蛋白和细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶4（CDK4）的蛋白表达降低。上述发现提示，EP可能通过调控p53信号通路及诱导铁死亡，促进MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞凋亡。
